summary:
Phase C (integration) is done. Typecheck, unit tests, build and the bundle check pass, and the new end-to-end suite scripts/e2e.mjs passes 15/15 against the production build (vite preview on port 5189, fresh Chrome profile, fake microphone, ~75 s). It reuses the capture flows instead of duplicating them: scripts/e2e-capture.mjs is now an importable module with the same CLI (still 6/6 on its own).
Fixes found by the e2e and the screenshot review:
- Shell (real mobile glitch): push transitions slide pages 28 px sideways, which overflowed the app column. Under mobile emulation the whole page zoomed out to ~93 % (layout viewport 418x905) for the length of every push slide, and headless taps missed. .ui-frame now has overflow-x: clip (unlike hidden, sticky bars keep working); the viewport stays 390x844 during transitions.
- Viewer data bug: changing a parameter and going back within 600 ms (e.g. transpose +1 then -1) left a stale debounced save that was flushed on unmount, so the score was stored at the intermediate value (+1 semitone). Fixed in useLiveScore.ts (drop the pending save when back to the stored value); the e2e catches it (c1 transposes +2/-2, c4 checks the ABC export is still K:G).
- Blank moment between push screens (AnimatePresence mode="wait"): measured 130-160 ms per transition, because exits faded with the ease-out curve and the old screen sat invisible for most of its exit. Exit opacity now uses an ease-in with the SAME durations (mount timing and capture's vinyl FLIP unchanged): 41-54 ms on library/viewer/settings/about transitions. Home -> Record stays ~124 ms because the Record screen's mount is heavy (left for phase D).
- Covers: a new transcription could get the same cover as its neighbour (1 in 10). New items now skip the covers of the 4 most recent items (pickCoverId(seed, avoid?) + db.recentCoverIds()), with 3 unit tests.
Cross-owner requests resolved: kit polish asked by settings, library and viewer (compact padding for full-width Segmented, ListRow wrap prop now used by Ajustes, unselected Chips inside a Sheet on --fill, Cover size accepts a CSS length, IconButton loading prop, useElementWidth exported, UI-KIT.md updated including the stagger/AnimatePresence note); engine-audio's recorder note (the level meter's AudioContext is resumed on the next touch or key when it starts suspended, for iOS); scripts/serve.mjs falls back to ss when lsof is missing (minimal Linux). Deferred with reasons: useAllScores() summaries (needs a db schema change and on-demand full docs for exports: phase D); the synchronous AudioContext constructor (inherent; capture's 520 ms deferral already hides it).
Also added to the e2e: viewer exports (MusicXML, MIDI, ABC, PDF with window.print stubbed) and an offline check (service worker active -> preview server stopped -> reload, play a demo, transcribe scale.wav), which covers the BRIEF's offline quality bar.
Final screenshots: 13 screens x light/dark = 26 files in docs/screenshots/final-*.png at 390x844 @2x, each reviewed with Read (individually or on contact sheets) against docs/reference and the BRIEF. README.md written in Spanish (Windows and Linux/macOS, LAN, build/preview, PWA, Capacitor steps not executed, architecture, scripts, limitations, credits).
Client feedback re-read before finishing: three new entries (share to Pauta, transcription accuracy + piano sound, score key/rhythm/hands), all assigned to other agents; nothing for integration to apply. Since ~16:30 the lead reassigned src/engine/**, src/data/demos.ts, test/fixtures/**, scripts/fixtures/**, public/soundfonts/**, src/assets/images.ts, src/features/viewer/**, src/types.ts and src/state/settings.ts to new agents; I made no edits there after that message, and my earlier edits there (recorder.ts, useLiveScore.ts, images.ts) are listed in requests for their owners.

public_api_notes:
E2E: node scripts/e2e.mjs [--url http://localhost:5189/] [--dev] [--build] [--only a,b,c1] [--headful] [--keep] [--verbose] (also npm run e2e). Default: if nothing answers at the URL it builds dist/ when missing, serves it with `node scripts/serve.mjs start 5189 --preview`, and stops it at the end; with --url an existing server is used as is. Fresh Chrome profile and download folder under <os tmpdir>/pauta/e2e/run-<ts>/ (deleted unless --keep). Check ids: a, b, c1-c3 (one per demo), c4 (exports), d1, d2, e, f1, f2, g1, g2, i (offline), h (no console/page/network problems while online). Exit 0 when nothing FAILs; the offline check prints SKIP against a dev server (no service worker). The offline check stops the preview server it started (or uses page.setOfflineMode with --url), so it runs last before h.
E2E selectors it relies on (keep them or update scripts/e2e.mjs): nav[aria-label="Principal"] a[aria-label=Inicio|Biblioteca|Ajustes] with aria-current; main.ui-page .ui-topbar__title; [aria-label="Escuchar"]; ul[aria-label="Partituras"] > li.lib-item, .lib-row__main, .lib-row__title; .vw-paper svg .abcjs-note; .vw-player[data-status=idle|loading|countin|playing|paused]; .vw-player__playbtn; .vw-player__slider input (position); .vw-paper .vw-on with abcjs-mm<m> abcjs-v<v> abcjs-n<i> classes; .vw-meta ('Sol mayor · 4/4 · 100 ppm'); the first .abcjs-key-signature (paths = accidentals); .abcjs-staff-wrapper.abcjs-l0 .abcjs-staff; button[aria-label="Ajustes de la partitura"]; .vw-sheet, .vw-sheet__tabs [role=radio]; [role=group][aria-label=Transponer] button[aria-label=Aumentar|Disminuir]; [role=radiogroup][aria-label=Manos|Tema] [role=radio]; button[aria-label="Más opciones"] + .ui-actionsheet .ui-actionsheet__item labels; .vw-print svg (PDF); button.ui-row .ui-row__title 'Exportar copia'; .ui-toast; plus the capture selectors listed in scripts/e2e-capture.mjs. Expected data: demo keys Sol mayor -> La mayor (Oda, Minueto) and Do mayor -> Re mayor (Preludio) after +2; the Oda's ABC export has T:Oda a la alegría and K:G.
scripts/e2e-capture.mjs exports: setBase(url), chromeArgs(fakeAudio?), importFlow(page, fixture, {video}), micFlow(page, seconds), tooShort(page), cancelProcessing(page), readScore(page, id|null), openHome, hashIs, currentHash, clickByText, loopWav, answers, sleep, ROOT, FIXTURES. Its own CLI runs only when executed directly.
UI kit additions (docs/UI-KIT.md): ListRow wrap?: boolean; IconButton loading?: boolean (spinner, inert, aria-busy); Cover size: number | string (CSS length; radius --r-sm for strings, override with style.borderRadius); useElementWidth(ref) exported from src/ui; full Segmented items use 8 px side padding through :where(), so screen CSS like .set-below .ui-seg__item still wins; unselected Chips inside a Sheet use --fill; .ui-frame clips horizontal overflow (never rely on content wider than the column); pageVariants exits keep 0.16 s (tab) / 0.18 s (push) but fade opacity with an ease-in [0.4, 0, 1, 1].
Data: db.ts recentCoverIds(count = 4): Promise<string[]> (cover ids of the latest items by createdAt). images.ts pickCoverId(seed, avoid?: Iterable<string>) walks from the hashed cover to the first one not in avoid (unchanged result without avoid). The capture pipeline uses both.
Shell transitions: AnimatePresence mode="wait" is unchanged; measured blank (max page opacity < 0.15) is now ~41-54 ms for library/viewer/settings/about and ~124 ms for Home -> Record.

requests.request: src/features/viewer/useLiveScore.ts: keep the fix in the debounced save effect (when the built params JSON equals the stored one, set pending.current = null before returning); without it a +1/-1 within 600 ms persists the intermediate params on close. scripts/e2e.mjs c1 + c4 detect a regression (ABC export must stay K:G). If playback is reworked (new sampler, pedal), keep .vw-player[data-status] values, .vw-player__playbtn and the .vw-on highlight with abcjs-mm/v/n classes, or update scripts/e2e.mjs accordingly.

src/engine/audio/recorder.ts startLevelMeter: I added an unlock that retries ctx.resume() on the next pointerdown/touchend/keydown while the meter's AudioContext is not running (iOS Safari keeps a context created outside the tap suspended; recording is unaffected) and removes the listeners on stop(). Keep it when reworking the recorder and verify the live bars on a real iPhone.

Keep the optional second parameter of pickCoverId(seed, avoid?): src/features/capture/pipeline.ts passes recentCoverIds() so neighbours never share a cover, and src/assets/images.test.ts covers it. Note: the working copy of images.ts has CRLF line endings from my scripted edit (git normalizes to LF on commit via .gitattributes); I did not touch it again after the reassignment.

scripts/e2e.mjs expects the 3 demos to keep their pinned keys (Sol mayor / Sol mayor / Do mayor), to transpose +2 to La / La / Re mayor with +2 sharps in the first key signature, and hands 'Derecha' to leave exactly one staff in the first system (.abcjs-staff-wrapper.abcjs-l0). If hand separation or clef choice changes (left hand in treble clef, anacrusis), re-run node scripts/e2e.mjs and adjust the expectations there if the new behaviour is intended.

useAllScores() (db.ts) loads every doc with its full notes array, and Library/Home keep them in React state; with hundreds of long transcriptions this costs memory and deserialization on every live-query update. Suggested: a summary-only live query (a lightweight table or projection kept in sync on create/update, db version 2) for lists, and fetch the full doc by id for exports/duplicate. Not done in phase C because it needs a schema migration plus changes in library actions and Home.

Home -> Record still shows ~124 ms of blank between screens (other transitions ~41-54 ms after the motion.ts change): the Record screen's mount is heavy (vinyl + plinth + tonearm gradients, LiveBars) and the AudioContext constructor blocks 80-240 ms at +520 ms. Options: lighter first frame for Record (mount the plinth/tonearm a frame later) or pre-render the vinyl layer.

README.md 'Limitaciones' says Pauta does not import YouTube or other web links (true for the phase C build). Update it, and add a check to scripts/e2e.mjs (e.g. a POSTed share-target file reaching Import), when 'Compartir con Pauta' lands.

docs/CONTINUAR.md section 4: mark integration as done (e2e 15/15 with node scripts/e2e.mjs, README.md, final screenshots docs/screenshots/final-*.png light/dark). Section 7, for phase D: useAllScores summaries; Home -> Record blank; real-device testing (iOS mic meter, Android install, HTTPS hosting); run node scripts/e2e.mjs on Linux once. After the piano-sound / accuracy / share work lands, refresh final-*.png and README (the FINAL prompt already covers it).

known_issues: HIGH (client, TOP PRIORITY, assigned to audio-accuracy / score-accuracy / piano-sound): transcription accuracy on real material (pedal, reverb, phone captures, detuned video audio) and the electric-keyboard playback timbre are below what the client expects; also tempo octave errors, chromatic spelling by harmonic context, anacrusis/triplets and register-based hand split (client feedback 16:20 and 16:35). Not an integration defect, but it is the main remaining product gap.
MEDIUM: useAllScores() loads every library item with its full notes (memory and live-query cost with large libraries). Deferred to phase D (needs a db schema change).
MEDIUM: Home -> Record keeps ~124 ms of blank between screens (heavy Record mount + synchronous AudioContext constructor at +520 ms). Other push/tab transitions dropped from 130-160 ms to 41-54 ms.

MEDIUM: not verified on real devices: iOS Safari (mic level meter unlock added but untested; mic and service worker need HTTPS), Android install as PWA, tab capture end to end (headless Chrome cannot pick a tab). Over plain HTTP on a LAN IP the phone cannot record or go offline (secure-context rule); documented in README.

LOW: what headless cannot prove: real sound output (the e2e verifies the AudioContext clock and the moving highlight only), the OS share sheet (shareOrDownload falls back to a download in headless Chrome), the print dialog (window.print is stubbed and the print sheet's systems are counted), haptics.

LOW: scripts/e2e.mjs was executed on Windows 11 only. The Linux path is coded (path.join, chrome-path.mjs, serve.mjs with lsof or ss, --no-sandbox) but was not run here; headless Linux audio output behaviour is untested.

LOW: the viewer renders the whole tune into one audio buffer (~23 MB per 90 s at 1x, much more for long pieces at slow speed) and re-renders on speed/metronome changes with a 60-150 ms gap (from the viewer report; the piano-sound work may change this).
LOW: cover de-duplication only looks at the 4 most recent items (10 covers in total), so older items can still share covers.
LOW: src/assets/images.ts has CRLF line endings in the working copy (my scripted edit; normalized to LF by git on commit). Left untouched after the reassignment.

INFO: the final screenshots and README describe the phase C build; the piano-sound, accuracy and share agents will change the viewer, settings and capture, so final-*.png and README need a refresh in phase D.
